Spells:
Alter Self (Harper1 Tran): Self becomes a choice of creature within 1 size category that has up to 5 HD for 50 min; possessions can remain or meld into the form
Cat's Grace (Harper2 Tran): Touched gains +4 Dexterity for 5 min
Charm Person (Harper1 Ench): R35' Target humanoid treats self as a trusted friend (save Will negates; +5 if being threatened) for 5 hr
Clairaudience/Clairvoyance (Harper3 Divi): 600' Self gains a choice of remote sight or hearing of a known location for 5 min
Comprehend Languages (Harper1 Divi): Allows self to understand touched written text and words spoken in any language by touched creatures for 50 min
Darkvision (Harper2 Tran): Gives touched 60' black and white vision in total darkness for 5 hr
Detect Thoughts (Harper2 Divi): 60' cone reveals the presence of minds and their surface thoughts (save Will presence only) for concentration up to 5 min
Eagle's Splendor (Harper2 Tran): Touched gains +4 Charisma for 5 min
Entangle (R1 Tran): R480' 40' radius entangles creatures (save Reflex inflicts half Speed; DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist ends) for 2 min
Erase (Harper1 Tran): R35' Two pages of writing vanish; magical writing requires a successful 1d20+5 caster check with a DC of 15
Feather Fall (Harper1 Tran): R35' 5 falling targets in a 10' radius slow to 60' per rd (save Will negates) for 5 rd
Invisibility (Harper2 Illu): Touched becomes invisible for 5 min; target attacking ends
Jump (Harper1 Tran): Touched gains +20 Jump checks for 5 min
Knock (Harper2 Tran): R150' Opens a stuck, barred, locked, or magically held door, chest, or shackle and suppresses Arcane Lock for 10 min
Light (Harper1 Evoc): Touched object emits a 20' bright light for 50 min
Locate Object (Harper2 Divi): Reveals the direction of a visualized object or kind of object found within 600' for 5 min; a sheet of lead blocks the spell
Magic Mouth (Harper2 Illu): R35' Enspells the target object or creature (save Will negates) so that a mouth appears on it and speaks up to 25 words in response to a specified trigger within 75'
Message (Harper1 Tran): R150' Allows self to exchange whispered messages with 5 targets for 50 min; messages can circumvent barriers, but 1' of stone, 1" of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3' of wood or dirt blocks the spell
Misdirection (Harper2 Illu): R35' Divination spells cast upon a target show the auras of another selected object or creature (save Will by the diviner negates) for 5 hr
Mount (Harper1 Conj): R35' Summons a riding horse with bit, bridle, and saddle that serves self for 10 hr
Nondetection (Harper3 Abju): Touched gains SR 16 vs. divination, or self or a possession gains SR 20, for 5 hr
Read Magic (Harper1 Divi): Allows self to read magical writing for 50 min
Scatterspray (Harper1 Tran): R35' Little items in 1' radius scatter, inflicting 1d8 on creatures w/in 10' (DC 14 Ref neg)
See Invisibility (Harper2 Divi): Allows self to see invisible and ethereal creatures and objects for 50 min
Shadow Mask (Harper2 Illu): Hides self face and gives +4 saves vs. light and dark and 50% protection from gaze attacks for 50 min
Sleep (Harper1 Ench): R150' 4 HD of creatures in a 10' radius fall asleep (save Will negates), moving upward from those with the lowest HD, for 5 min
Spider Climb (Harper1 Tran): Gives touched a 20' climb Speed and the ability to climb walls and ceilings for 50 min; the target also retains its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class while climbing
Suggestion (Harper3 Ench): R35' Target follows a reasonable suggestion (save Will negates) for 5 hr
Tongues (Harper3 Divi): Allows touched to communicate in any language for 50 min
Undetectable Alignment (Harper3 Abju): R35' Conceals the target's alignment from divination (save Will negates) for 24 hr
